comparisons.competitor_heading: How is AI citation tracking different from traditional SEO rank tracking?
comparisons.competitor_excerpt: Traditional rank tracking monitors your position in a static list of results for specific keywords. AI citation tracking monitors whether your content appears at all in dynamically generated responses – and in what context. The shift is from “what position am I in?” to “am I a trusted source that AI recommends?”
